description: Find Textures (hover animations) by words, category, tag, placement, size or Light badge. Call first when the user wants a hover effect, micro-interaction or motion. Returns up to 10 compact rows plus facets; deterministic order.

category.description: One category slug from a previous result's facets.

light_only.description: Only Textures with the Light badge (every perf line green).

max_kb.description: Only Textures whose measured js + css is at or under this many KB.

placement.description: Where it will sit: inline (button, link), contained (card, tile, hero panel) or background (a layer under content).

query.description: Words from the user's request: what moves, where it sits, a mood (e.g. 'calm grid for a hero', 'magnetic button').

sort.description: Default featured (relevance when query is set).

tag.description: One tag from a previous result's facets.

name: search_textures
title: Search Textures
